title: Grateful Dead Live at Pauley Ballroom, U. of California on 1970-06-21
lineage: unknown transfer to WAV-1648 marked 2nd-Gen > Wavelab (small edits & speed adjust) > CD-Wave > TLH > FLAC 1648 tagged.
source: AUD said to have been recorded by Harry Ely

ai_review.summary: Echoey audience tape that grows on you, highlighted by a novel NFA → St. Stephen segue but overall a forgettable show.
ai_review.review: The recording is an audience capture in a cavernous hall with noticeable echo and no soundboard feed, making the mix fair at best. Musically the concert has a few bright spots – a shredding Easy Wind, an intriguing Candyman jam, and especially the reversed NFA → St. Stephen transition – but most listeners find the performance uneven and not essential.

ai_rating.rationale: One reviewer rates it very poorly (0 stars) citing bad recording and forgettable performance, while another gives 4 stars for the unique NFA‑>St. Stephen segue; the mixed feedback leads to an average rating around three stars.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Cavernous hall sound with strong echo, no soundboard source, occasional gun/shotgun noise, ends abruptly; rated C by the Deadhead Taping Compendium.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Unusual segue order flipping the typical St. Stephen → The Other One to NFA → St. Stephen, with a long jam early in The Other One; overall pacing described as uneven but occasionally fierce.

band_member_comments.Jerry: His moaning on Candyman is noted and liked by the reviewer.
band_member_comments.Drums: Unclear gunshot sound may be a drum effect; no explicit comments on drumming.
